audio.description: Bare companion audio filename under data/video/ (the caller supplies the directory prefix), or null for no companion audio. The MP4's own audio track is deliberately not decoded.

length.description: Cutscene length in seconds. Not a balancing file, so the usual 0-60 balancing seconds convention does not bind it; a generous cap allows longer cutscenes.

trigger.description: The trigger point this cutscene fires at. A new trigger point is a schema bump. 'start_game' fires the moment the player clicks Start Game, over the run's own construction (game/main.py's GameState.LOADING runs its checkpoints behind it) -- never on Continue/Load Save, which go straight to the loading screen.

video.description: Bare video filename under data/video/ (the caller supplies the directory prefix, matching game/main.py's existing data_dir / 'video' / <filename> composition).

description: The cutscene registry (D4, planning/TutorialPLAN.md): id -> {video, audio, length, trigger}. Open registry (additionalProperties keyed by id) so later phases add entries (e.g. a boss cutscene) with no schema change; only a new trigger enum value is a schema bump. TU-1 seeds the two entries this phase requires: 'intro' (migrated later, TU-5, from game/main.py's hardcoded path) and 'first_end_turn' (new).
title: cutscenes
